scope: Concrete mode1 Float32 packet and sample-producing branch, with fixed-rate mono/stereo reconstruction. No assertion that this is the active backend in every hosted Cubase context.

dispatch.selection: Explicit mode1, or mode2 factory returning nil; broader host selection is independently documented in rate-selection.

fields.0x48: i64 cumulative generated frames before terminal trim

coefficient_contract.series: term=sum=index=1; do { q=RN64(half/index); index=RN64(index+1); q=RN64(q*q); term=RN64(term*q); sum=RN64(sum+term); } while(term>=RN64(sum*epsilon))
coefficient_contract.sinc: h[0]=1; increment=RN64(RN64(RN64(cutoff+cutoff)*piBits400921fb54442d18)*2^-9); h[i]=RN64(system_sin(RN64(i*increment))/RN64(i*increment)), i1..32768. Native pair invokes second index before first.
coefficient_contract.normalization: sum is ordered RN64 addition h[512],h[1024],...,h[32768]; scale=RN64(1/FMA(sum,2,1)); each h[i]=RN64(h[i]*scale).
coefficient_contract.math_boundary: Exact original indirect symbol resolves to _sin. Reconstruction uses host C sin; neither target execution nor equivalence of every OS/libm implementation has been demonstrated.
coefficient_contract.early_label_correction: An early message called beta8.6. Original MOVKs and implementation constants decode8.96; candidate always used original bits. Corrected before oracle validation or sealing.

sample_contract.fresh: Fresh prefix64 doubles equals first Float32 widened, or zero for NULL; input begins storage[64], logical consumed counter starts64. Fresh flag clears even on a zero call.
sample_contract.later: Input begins storage[128], logical consumed counter starts0. Working sample center always restarts storage[64].
sample_contract.terminal: Append64 copies of the positive call last Float32 frame, or zero for NULL/zero call. Local input limit increases64; cumulative real input does not.
sample_contract.phase: While trunc_i64(phase)>=512 and logical index<local limit: phase=RN64(phase-512); increment logical index and every channel center. Then emit a whole channel frame if logical index<limit; phase=RN64(phase+step); repeat.
sample_contract.left_taps: m=trunc_i32(phase); f=RN64(phase-Double(m)); acc=+0; for k0..63, w=FMA(f,d[m+512k],h[m+512k]); acc=FMA(center[-k],w,acc).
sample_contract.right_taps: q=RN64(512-phase); m=trunc_i32(q); f=RN64(q-Double(m)); for k0..63, w=FMA(f,d[m+512k],h[m+512k]); acc=FMA(center[k+1],w,acc). Only then narrow Float32.
sample_contract.carry: Copy128 doubles starting center-64 into each buffer beginning. Storage outside copied region is retained.
sample_contract.count: Always add generated frames to cumulative generated. Terminal target=trunc_i64(RN64(ratio*Double(cumulative real input))); if target<new cumulative generated, return max(current generated+target-new cumulative generated,0); otherwise return current generated. Retained generated counter is not reduced.
sample_contract.reset: 0x10030aeb8 clears phase and both native counters, sets fresh1; it does not clear storage/tables. Destroy/create is required for a genuinely fresh reconstruction seek.
sample_contract.resize: For caller n>capacity, packet changes capacity=n+1024 then reallocates zero-filled channel buffers, without resetting phase/counters/fresh. Fixed channel count subset avoids reconfiguration/free-count uncertainty.
sample_contract.partition: Short first blocks are supported and may retain zero/stale gaps. No partition invariance is asserted.

defensive_contract.rates: Integral8000..192000 inclusive, channels1 or2; equal rates retain filtering; nearest-even and noFTZ/FIZ.
defensive_contract.limits: At most1m caller input frames,16m cumulative real input and visible output. Native valid internal storage extents checked before any mutation.
defensive_contract.native_bounds: Nonfresh terminal input in [capacity-62,capacity] would write beyond capacity+129 doubles; reject transactionally. Calls n>capacity grow by1024 and may be safe. App8192 blocks are within initial capacity.
defensive_contract.zero: Zero calls require NULL source. Zero nonfinal calls reproduce state mutation. One terminal call permitted, then reset/create; repeated native terminal behavior is outside wrapper policy.
defensive_contract.samples: Finite normal-or-zero Float32 inputs and generated outputs; nonzero subnormal output rejects. All failures preserve caller output/count and state.
defensive_contract.publication: Only returned region is copied to caller. Native generated writes outside returned region are not claimed as compatible ABI side effects.

open_review: Independent coefficient/sample oracle, current application integration review, and final source snapshots pending.
